objective: Measure interaction-local negative, zero, and positive normalized multiscale correction values on all 16 frozen development contexts before any CCLVR optimizer step.
hypothesis: The C3 multiscale adapter contains at least four interaction decisions best served by each of the negative, zero, and positive arms, allowing a non-degenerate three-arm local value policy to be trained.
falsification_criterion: Training remains blocked if any arm has fewer than four best-arm interaction labels after the frozen 0.01 minimum-benefit rule, if any local intervention changes a pre-target interaction, or if any identity, source hash, hook, or zero-dose check fails.

checkpoint.role: frozen C3 multiscale adapter and failed nearest router mechanism

invariants: same C3 checkpoint, episode start, action trajectory, and seed across all paired arms
zero dose captured once per identity and reused as the explicit abstain arm for every interaction
negative and positive doses activate only at the selected interaction
all pre-target interaction L1 values remain equal to the zero trajectory
runtime features come only from the zero-dose trajectory
episode 1799 is absent from feature extraction, labels, calibration, coverage selection, and training

local_return.definition: For interaction i and arm a, loss_i(a) is the weighted suffix mean L1 plus terminal-interaction final-frame L1 plus suffix horizon-L1 slope. Value_i(a) is loss_i(zero)-loss_i(a).
local_return.target_rule: Choose the higher-value nonzero arm only when its value is at least 0.01; otherwise choose zero.

data_admission.coverage_definition: Fraction of admitted local decisions whose oracle target is a nonzero arm.
data_admission.failure_action: Do not implement or train D1-D4. Expand development-only local probes or return to retrieval and mechanism redesign.

artifact_policy: Never overwrite an output root. Retain identity-bearing shards only for audit. Emit a separate training bank with no context_id, episode_id, seed, or start_idx keys and hash all raw shards into the admission manifest.
post_admission_authority: Implement and run D1-D4 at 64 steps on eight GPUs only. No 512-step confirmation plan is authorized.
claim_boundary: Development-only local counterfactual data admission. Passing licenses the frozen 64-step ablation screen; it does not establish held-out improvement, dataset-level generalization, publication-level novelty, or RSI.
